state:
**Goal `ext-image-analysis` — `Novis\Image` compares, hashes, summarises and draws. Stages 2, 3 and 4 are on disk: comparison, hashing, placeholders, the palette and QR codes. Stages 5 (text) and 6 (the feature proofs) are not.**

The design is ADR 0120 §§ 8 and 9, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets, the crates included. No session re-decides one.

Stage 4 on disk: the component's `qr` export over the `qrcode` crate (default features off), whose module doc `extensions/image/src/qr.rs` defines `size` (default 256), `margin` (default 4), the level (default `Medium`) and the format (default PNG); `QrCode::render` in `extensions/image/nvs/QrCode.nvs`, the manifest's `Codec::qr` and `QrLevel`; the four QR host checks in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs`, which read each code back with `rqrr` (a workspace dev-dependency, `image` feature off); and `tests/conformance/novis/image-a-qr-code-is-a-square-png.nvst`. `rule:core-classes/image-one-entry-point-per-job`'s *Not shipped* paragraph says what is on disk.

The component's own unit tests run with `cargo test --lib` inside `extensions/image/`, a workspace of its own. `cargo deny check licenses` passes with both new crates; `cargo deny check bans` fails on a `nvs-image` wildcard dev-dependency that was already there before this goal's QR slice.

items.text: **The `text` step and `text` source** (`rule:core-classes/image-one-entry-point-per-job`, `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`, ADR 0120 § 9) — replace the `missing` arms at `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:471` and `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:621` with a new `text.rs` over `ab_glyph` (Latin only, kerning, `maxWidth` wraps at a word, `align`), its options at `wit/image.wit:204`; follow `qr.rs`'s split of a core function with host unit tests.

**`Image::text`, `Image::measureText` and `Font::fromBytes`** — beside `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:329`; `Font::fromBytes` checks the header in Novis and throws `ParseError` on bytes that are no font (goal § *Standing decisions*).

**The text checks** — the record's `nvs-ext` test `text_renders_latin_with_the_font_given_as_bytes` and its siblings in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs:1`, and the case `tests/conformance/novis/image-font-from-bytes-refuses-bytes-that-are-not-a-font.nvst`. A font fixture needs a permissive licence (OFL is not in `deny.toml`, which covers crates only; check the fixture's licence is acceptable before committing one).

backlog: Stage 6, the feature proofs for every `Novis\Image` member and enum this goal added (`bun nv proofs --owed`; the goal record's stage 6 checks).
`cargo deny check bans` fails on `nvs-image.workspace = true` in `crates/nvs-ext/Cargo.toml:83` being a wildcard (no `version`); a gap for whoever owns `deny.toml`.
